column3: BSB moves “have received a faith as precious as ours” to the end.
BSB adds “we need” and follows the critical text with “by His own glory and excellence.”
BSB renders “blind, being short-sighted” as “nearsighted to the point of blindness.”
BSB renders “the entrance will be richly supplied” as “you will receive a lavish reception.”
BSB follows the critical text with “I will always remind you” (μελλήσω); the Textus Receptus reads “I will not neglect to remind you.”
BSB renders “the more certain prophetic word” as “the word of the prophets as confirmed beyond doubt.”
BSB follows the critical text with “men spoke from God” (ἀπὸ); the Textus Receptus reads “holy men of God spoke.”
